articles.title: ENHYPEN’s Jay Between Two Worlds
articles.description: Park Jong-seong has always occupied the beautiful, uncomfortable space between identities. Now, in Polo Ralph Lauren and on the cover of Vogue Korea, he makes that tension look like destiny. There is a particular gravity that settles over Jay when he enters a room dressed well. Not arrogance — something quieter. A kind of settled certainty that his body, his clothes, and the space around him have arrived at an agreement. Standing in front of the Vogue Korea lens in Polo Ralph Lauren for the maga
articles.summary: ENHYPEN member Jay is featured on the cover of Vogue Korea wearing Polo Ralph Lauren, where the article explores his identity as someone who exists between different worlds and cultures. The piece highlights how his confident presence and style create a sense of poise and certainty.
